'''Chalik''' was a male [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] commander of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]], where he was killed by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]s.
